detailed_findings.finding: The denominator factors are correctly inverted in Z[[q]] using geometric series, valid because each s in I is positive.
The proof explicitly justifies coefficient extraction at q^j by bounding each multiplicity m_s via m_s <= j/s, so only finitely many terms contribute.
The bijection between multiplicity tuples (m_s) and finite multisets lambda of I is correct and matches the stated weight function wt(lambda).

reason: The proof gives the standard and correct formal-power-series expansion of the product, justifies coefficient extraction for a fixed j by showing only finitely many tuples can contribute, and then identifies the contributing tuples with finite multisets of I. This yields exactly the claimed signed enumeration over X_j. It matches the lemma sketch and role in the assembly, and it does not rely on any undeclared or forbidden dependency.
